| Good morning Friend,
Mississippi is at a turning point for education. Just days ago, **HB2 — landmark school choice legislation — passed the Mississippi House and has now moved to the Senate** , marking one of the most significant advances for parental empowerment and education freedom our state has seen in years. If enacted, this legislation would expand options for families, put students first, and begin reshaping how education works for Mississippi children. subject: The wrong approach to the Voting Rights Act

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: Republican Justices Appear Poised to Destroy What’s Left of the Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012026_1&amount=25]
We'll hand this straight to Mother Jones, Team: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
During recent oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Fuel our work with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012026_1&amount=35]

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down redistricting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
“ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $35 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012026_1&amount=35]

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Supreme Court Weighs Arguments for and Against the Future of Women's Sports

All eyes turned to Washington, D.C., last week to watch two consequential cases before the Supreme Court. When the decisions are
rendered this summer, they will inform whether states have a right to ban biological boys and men from girls’ and women’s sports.

They will decide on women’s safety on sporting fields, their right to privacy in the locker room, and whether women will continue
to enjoy the rights afforded to them by Title IX.

When the lines of biological reality are blurred, it deprives women and girls of the equal opportunities Title IX was established
to protect.

Our guests today have a word of caution before we celebrate too much. Angela Morabito and Paul Zimmerman are with the Defense of Freedom Institute (DFI), a nonpartisan, nonprofit organization focused on providing thoughtful, conservative solutions to challenges in the areas of education, workforce, labor, and employment policy. When the decisions are rendered this summer, they will inform whether states have a right to ban biological boys and men from girls’ and women’s sports. They will decide on women’s safety on sporting fields, their right to privacy in the locker room, and whether women will continue to enjoy the rights afforded to them by Title IX. body:
It’s weird to be on the other side of one of these messages.

[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._OCw183IJaOrC5Jq4kA)**I just want to say I'm sorry, Peter. You deserve better.**
You've probably already gotten 50 texts today from folks asking for your hard-earned dollar & the last thing you want to deal with is another politician looking for a handout.
I get it because I also get those on my phone and laptop. So being the sender this time feels a little awkward.
**This is Troy Downing. I'm a combat veteran, husband, father & conservative Congressman fighting to advance President Trump's agenda.**
Not in a million years did I ever expect to hold federal office.
But when I saw how things were being run in DC, I felt a responsibility to act.
_Now I'm bringing Montana values to the Beltway._
This midterm cycle isn't just another election. It's the key to who controls the House - continuing the MAGA agenda or succumbing to a radical liberal takeover.
Democrats have a war chest in cash aimed at crushing MAGA Republicans like me.
**__They've already funneled massive amounts into House races to wipe out every conservative standing in their way.__**
They can't stand a candidate with my profile – someone who's served our country & isn't afraid to shake up the status quo.
But no matter how hard they come after me, I won't back down.
**_Here's the bottom line:_ **_a win for someone like me will bring us one step closer to protecting our conservative majority._
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._gkQiFG2IDLMijMEw)[ I hate to ask, but the fate of America's future is in your hands... Can you take a leap of faith with a combat vet & chip in to my campaign today?](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)[DONATE NOW
](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)If you can't contribute, I understand. Just know that your prayers mean the world to me.
Thank you and God bless,
Troy| |

Patriot, In the wake of the assassination attempt on my father's life - and the assassination of my friend Charlie Kirk - the opposition has made things clear:

**Violence is all they have left.** They don't want to talk. Or debate. Because they know they'll lose. So how do we as patriots live in an America where so many people openly despise us... and wish us harm? Well, that's something the Trump family knows a lot about. In fact, I've had so many people ask me how our family has endured living under constant attack for a decade that I decided to write a book about it. **It 's called _Under Siege: My Family 's Fight to Save Our Nation._**_ _

I completely understand how you feel because I would feel the same way.

I am genuinely sorry, Friend.
Really, I am.
I am sorry some folks threaten to remove you from the GOP if you don't donate.
I am sorry some folks masquerade as President Trump to try and fool you.
I am sorry some folks don't even thank you for donating.
It is enough to drive you nuts. And I completely understand how you feel because I get the same messages. I'll get bombarded with texts and emails asking me for money but it's hard to tell who sends them all.
And if I do pitch in a few bucks, I'd probably get pestered even more - without any acknowledgement of my contribution.
It's wrong, and I'm doing things differently.
This is Steve Scalise. First of all, I want to personally thank you for everything you've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans thus far. [You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement - and we only won with your hard work and support.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaefso3rvs37i6458829mo5kp11qsbd8bj573jno_rp22sh2s8i6eor0sjgmapb1c3h2bs)
Thank you for having the grit and determination to stand up to the Democrat Machine at the height of its power.
Unfortunately, the Democrats have regrouped faster than anyone thought possible.
They're ALREADY unloading 50 million dollars into enough battleground districts to flip the House. They're ALREADY dragging President Trump into court.
[In other words, we really need some more support right now to keep fighting.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh45j23gqk9n95kuc4forijp0g5k0mi452hji39g_rp22sh2s8i6eor0sjgmapb1c3h2bs)

BUT if you can contribute - even if it's just a few bucks - it would go a long way. Especially right now.
We have no choice but to hit our upcoming fundraising goal. Because if we fail, the Democrat Machine will crush us in every battleground district, barge back into power, and effectively BLOCKADE President Trump's entire legislative agenda.
[So I am sorry I even have to ask you this, but can you please pitch in before our BIGGEST deadline of the year?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrt8kjv9ocf68lhf1h0078aantuvot8gn9v3udmo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0sjgmapb1c3h2bs)

* We're already **profitable after just two years**(Most start-ups never become profitable).
* We operate with**80% gross margins and 24% net income**(Great margins).
* That puts _ The Flyover_ in the **top 1% of media start-ups** (Top 1%!).

**The three most common ways investors can realize returns are:**
1. **A Sale:** A larger media company or strategic partner could acquire _The Flyover_. (If that day comes, we'd only partner with those who share our values. CNN or New York Times need not apply.)
2. **Public Listing: **The future could include listing shares on a stock exchange, giving investors freedom to buy and sell.
3. **Profit Distributions (Dividends):** Because we're profitable now, unlike most start-ups, dividends are a real possibility.

**To recap: Sale. Listing. The first big race of 2026 for Democrats isn't a congressional or senate race, it's a Wisconsin Supreme Court seat that is up for grabs in April.
Trump has been conducting a full-on assault of state Supreme Courts across the country in his second term. First, he used Elon Musk's cash to try and buy the Wisconsin Supreme Court last Spring. Then later that year, he attempted a takeover of the PA Supreme Court.
Stopping Trump from stacking state Supreme Courts is paramount. These courts decide election laws and even outcomes. If MAGA captures them, Trump can rig elections, lock in one-party rule, and clear the path to a third term.
MAGA's WI Supreme Court candidate for the April election, Maria Lazar, shows Trump's endgame:

Troupis was also involved in the fake elector scheme for Wisconsin, which he was later indicted for on a felony charge. In November, Donald Trump issued a pardon for him.

## A tale of two tragedies...
Renee Good's death in Minnesota was both tragic and uncessary.
I don't think she was a political terorist but she did break the law multiple times and she was misguided by the teachings of the Left.
Yet once again, her death is being twisted to fit a narrative.
If you listen to the rhetoric of the Left - almost every politician and most of the legacy media, they portray her death as cold blooded murder.
She was "gunned down" by an ICE agent.
She was "killed in cold blood at point blank range."
They make it appear as though she did nothing wrong, she was just innocent bystander or at worst just citizen making her voice heard by exercising her Constitutional first amendment rights.
Interesting take.
Let's break it down by comparing it to a very similar case--one that the Left treated very differently.
The next time some one of the Left makes the case that Renee Good's murder was in cold blood, ask them one simple question.
Was Ashli Babbit murdered in cold blood? ...

**What the Founders Believed About God -- And Why It Still Matters**
One of the most repeated myths in modern America is that the Founding Fathers were indifferent or even hostile toward Christianity. We are told they wanted faith locked away in private life, far removed from public discourse and national identity. But when we let the Founders speak for themselves, a very different picture emerges. The men who shaped this nation did not see faith as a threat to liberty. They saw it as liberty's greatest safeguard.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. clean_body: There is nothing more patriotic than speaking out against abuses of power. One year ago today, Donald Trump swore an oath to protect and defend the Constitution of the United States. Here is the truth: Donald Trump's weaponization of government against his political opponents is a direct attack on our democracy. This is the kind of stuff we see in countries many of you have served in: where if you speak out against the people in charge, you are thrown in prison or worse. Now it's happening here. He threatens the media and universities with financial pain. He threatens members of the House and Senate with arrest, prosecution, and hanging for speech he doesn't like. He withholds funds from states with leadership that opposes him or his policies. It's as un-American as it gets. In the 250th year of the United States of America, there is no group better positioned to speak out against these abuses than the Veterans and Military families who have sacrificed for this country. At VoteVets, we're prepared to lead the fight to protect our democracy. We'll do it electorally, we'll mobilize veterans, and we'll do it in the courts. But we can't do it alone. name: Aria, United We Dream
subject: We do a lot with your support, Peter
body:
Our communities will stand against authoritarianism. | | | Peter, a year ago to date, this administration was officially sworn in, and with it, they ushered in a wave of new challenges and threats against everyday working people, including immigrants, nationwide. **Yet throughout this past year, our communities have demonstrated true commitment to each other. We’ve organized and taken action to keep each other safe.** Our work has never been more important, and with your incredible support, we’re able to achieve so much:
* DACA faced unprecedented attacks over the course of 2025, creating confusion and uncertainty as more than a dozen DACA recipients were detained despite their valid status. United We Dream was there to help make sense of it and provide immediate resources.

* Halfway through the year, a federal court abruptly halted the _Texas Dream Act_ , a 24-year-old law ensuring immigrant students could pay the same in-state tuition as their peers. This decision goes beyond a policy change, threatening the futures of thousands of young Texans seeking education and opportunity.

* While federal agents terrorized city streets, from LA to Chicago to Minneapolis, disappearing people with no due process, United We Dream has provided timely resources to help keep our communities safe.

**Your support was integral to all of these efforts****, Peter****— so I’m asking you now:****** [**Help us do more by making a contribution. Any amount that works for your budget will make a difference for our people-powered movement to uplift immigrant youth and protect our clean_body: Our communities will stand against authoritarianism. | | | Peter, a year ago to date, this administration was officially sworn in, and with it, they ushered in a wave of new challenges and threats against everyday working people, including immigrants, nationwide. Yet throughout this past year, our communities have demonstrated true commitment to each other. We’ve organized and taken action to keep each other safe. Our work has never been more important, and with your incredible support, we’re able to achieve so much: DACA faced unprecedented attacks over the course of 2025, creating confusion and uncertainty as more than a dozen DACA recipients were detained despite their valid status. United We Dream was there to help make sense of it and provide immediate resources. Halfway through the year, a federal court abruptly halted the Texas Dream Act , a 24-year-old law ensuring immigrant students could pay the same in-state tuition as their peers. This decision goes beyond a policy change, threatening the futures of thousands of young Texans seeking education and opportunity. While federal agents terrorized city streets, from LA to Chicago to Minneapolis, disappearing people with no due process, United We Dream has provided timely resources to help keep our communities safe. Your support was integral to all of these efforts**, Peter— so I’m asking you now:**** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | The respective merchants of record for transactions to United We Dream Network are ActBlue Charities Inc. | 2026 is a make or break election year for democracy.
All of the talking heads are talking about the House and Senate elections, and yes, those will be consequential. But here's the truth most political pundits and election analysts are missing:
The fate of Democracy will also hinge on often overlooked and underappreciated state Supreme Courts races.
As MAGA witnessed the formation of a massive blue wave in 2025, they started working on desperate countermeasures, launching an all-out blitz of anti-democratic election rigging efforts at the state level--rewriting elections laws to make it harder for Democrats to vote and gerrymandering maps.
The constitutionality of their actions will ultimately be decided by state Supreme Courts. That means whoever controls these courts will control the fate of our Democracy:
---

32 states will have state Supreme Court elections in 2026 including the key swing states of Arizona, Michigan, Georgia, and Wisconsin. If MAGA loyalists capture these courts, they'll green-light voter suppression and rigged maps as "constitutional".
That's why Defend Our Courts is stepping up once again. In 2025, when control of the PA Supreme Court was on the line, we helped lead the defense of this court and secure a 30+ point victory for the Democratic justices.
Now we're taking that winning formula national.
The national party is going to be stretched thin. With dozens of competitive House and Senate races, state court elections will risk being ignored. We can't let that happen, not when the entire guardrail of democracy is on the line. [The sooner we get moving, the stronger we'll be in every state. We need to start preparing our defense now and we can't do it alone. Elizabeth Warren headshot [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP35/1/80994/images/CADEM_ElizabethWarren.jpg]Listen, we need Democrats to win in 2026.
We can’t afford another two years of an unchecked and unbound Trump Administration.
Families literally cannot afford any more inaction on the affordability crisis.
But we can’t just talk the talk about this being the most important election of our lifetimes, we have to put our money where our mouth is.
So I recently announced I’m donating over $400,000 from my campaign account to 23 state parties — including the California Democratic Party — to help Democrats win up and down the ballot in November. There’s more on my decision below — and if you’re in the place to join me in making sure Democrats win big in 2026, please split a donation between the California Democratic Party and our campaign now. Alaska. Arizona. California. Colorado. Florida. Georgia. Iowa. Kentucky. Maine. Michigan. Minnesota. Mississippi. Nebraska. New Hampshire. New York. New Jersey. Nevada. North Carolina. Ohio. Pennsylvania. Texas. Virginia. Wisconsin.
These states are home to some of the most competitive races of the cycle — and where this money can make a real difference for a majority in Congress and taking back power in state legislatures and Governor offices. These are elections that we can win if we invest in state infrastructure early and we can take on the billionaires and big corporations throwing money into these races.
This is one of the best ways to guarantee Democrats can actually make our plans a reality. Because we can only make change if we have the majorities to fight for it.
You make this work possible, and there’s a lot more we have to do as a team in order to fight hard and win big in 2026. So, if you’re able, split a donation of $ or anything you can to our campaign and the California Democratic Party so we can take back power in 2026, stop Trump’s unchecked corruption, and pass our plans to make our government work for working people. It’s a solemn day

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123689228/596245285/-629675555?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmU2ODUzMDEtMmJmNi1mMDExLThkNGMtMDAyMjQ4MmQyNzliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Fl8kTy6YRiRe693h1M2CV85dXjAE6nOuh1D_SlfLZYA=) One year ago today, Donald Trump entered the White House with a Republican Congress and a Cabinet full of billionaires to do his bidding. Today is a solemn day as we reflect on all that the President and his allies have done over the last year—from rolling back progress on climate change to slashing funding for healthcare and food assistance to driving up costs and making life harder for so many hardworking people. **[Today more than ever, I know that there is a lot of work to be done if we’re going to put an end to Trump’s disastrous agenda. That work starts with defending the House— _and keeping OR-05 blue._ Will you chip in a few dollars now to help me defend this seat?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123689229/596245286/2138236586?refcode=email_012026_trump&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C75%2C100%2C250%2C500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmU2ODUzMDEtMmJmNi1mMDExLThkNGMtMDAyMjQ4MmQyNzliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Fl8kTy6YRiRe693h1M2CV85dXjAE6nOuh1D_SlfLZYA=)** | | [Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123689230/596245287/2138236586?refcode=email_012026_trump&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C75%2C100%2C250%2C500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmU2ODUzMDEtMmJmNi1mMDExLThkNGMtMDAyMjQ4MmQyNzliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Fl8kTy6YRiRe693h1M2CV85dXjAE6nOuh1D_SlfLZYA=)

From day one of his second term, Donald Trump got to work pushing his ridiculous policies on Oregonians and the American people.
He rammed through a trash budget bill that cut funding for Medicaid and SNAP while giving tax handouts to billionaires and huge corporations.
He dismantled the Department of Education and shut down programs that help our kids succeed.
He authorized the “full force” of the military against his own people, and sent the National Guard into Portland.
He even targeted 56 Democrats and me after we stood up to him for sending his goons into our cities and for calling out his BS.
_Despite all of this, my Republican colleagues in Congress have done nothing to stop him._
But I’m fighting back. I’m working to restore funding for Medicaid and SNAP, protect and expand public education, lower costs for hardworking families, and keep our communities safe.
As we look ahead to the second year under this administration, I know there’s still a lot of work to be done to keep up this fight—and I’m ready to continue this work for Oregon and for our country.
**[This November is our best chance to put a stop to Trump’s ridiculous policies and put Oregonians first in Congress—but we need to protect this seat in order to do that. | | "I promise if you ever have to wear my shoes, you will want Doug Lloyd to walk that path with you." -- Lori Post, sister of homicide victim Terri Greene
Last month, I shared one of the most high-profile cold murder cases I have ever prosecuted. Today, I want to tell you about another. It is the brutal double homicide of Michael and Terri Greene at their rural Grand Ledge home that shook Eaton County to its core.
Eaton County has long been known as a safe place to live, where people leave their doors unlocked. That sense of security was shattered in September 2011, when Terri Greene's parents discovered that their daughter and her husband, Michael Greene, a retired Michigan State Police detective, had been brutally murdered. Michael was found inside their home. Terri was found floating in their backyard pond, with a wheelbarrow over her lifeless body. The case was featured on a TV crime show series: [Murder Comes to Town, Investigation Discovery](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001jtiBR-5nL9b2R26x8nhnl1dzZ8N68b1qNrB3kXHeiq0G5-7rGc4tKiJk5xaagxfIZVBsyTWrwJxP2YDNIrO0KUujyArOAfc8J_qlq6qlXfCqayW8T_qRDjuiqcz0ttdxQKza_f9CYCEv_yxaIFNcJ5FPZC7eIb8VCsMcFTJGitvaEcZbpnpr9R2t2Q9eA3-CTLXnUHVREFzQoxSAwP7bTqp3pbifgsoDEvPu7MtjrQEkZfP8ISHTXf8sZz7yqTvX&c=__bCNPZY7fxrPIxzHwHLjEVtWm9fOT6DbIojk8Pv5i5IQidJzZ1HNA==&ch=AAKHvFrXcT0XtYbZ8-orp59OOYY8m-KaMog4Gmz7gFQXbtozEcVh_Q==)
At the time, I was serving as Chief Assistant Prosecutor of Eaton County and was immediately assigned as the lead prosecutor. With no suspect and very little evidence, our team began methodically following every lead. That included drafting piggyback search warrants to track activity on stolen credit cards taken from the home.
Those efforts would eventually pay off, but not before the killer nearly got away with it.
Working closely with Eaton and Ingham County detectives, we identified the suspected killer as Christopher Perrien. What made this case especially disturbing was that Perrien was already a convicted felon housed in the Eaton County Jail when the home invasion and double homicide occurred. He had been granted work release by the court. Instead of going to work, he spent his days driving through rural Eaton County, casing homes and committing home invasions. He was ultimately identified in part because of his distinctive red Pontiac Trans Am, a vehicle law enforcement knew he prized above everything else.
After Perrien was stopped by police, investigators obtained warrants for his storage unit. Inside, they found Mike Greene's stolen firearm and credit cards. A GPS device taken from Perrien's car became the most critical piece of evidence, though its admissibility was a concern.
This case became one of the first in Michigan where GPS metadata was accessed through a search warrant and successfully used at trial. That data, or breadcrumbs, placed Perrien at the murder scene and at the locations where the stolen credit cards were used. Our prosecution not only secured justice for the Greene family, it helped change Michigan case law on the use of cellphone and GPS data in criminal prosecutions.
We also exposed a serious public safety failure. When dangerous criminals are granted work release without proper vetting, communities pay the price.
After a jury trial lasting four weeks, I secured a first-degree murder conviction. Justice was served. And the people of Eaton County were reminded that their safety will always come first.
That is the kind of proven dedication and leadership I will bring as Michigan's next Attorney General: Law-focused. Victim-centered. And unwavering in the pursuit of justice.

clean_body: Safety for Eaton County | | | | | == | | | == | | "I promise if you ever have to wear my shoes, you will want Doug Lloyd to walk that path with you." -- Lori Post, sister of homicide victim Terri Greene Last month, I shared one of the most high-profile cold murder cases I have ever prosecuted. Today, I want to tell you about another. It is the brutal double homicide of Michael and Terri Greene at their rural Grand Ledge home that shook Eaton County to its core. Eaton County has long been known as a safe place to live, where people leave their doors unlocked. That sense of security was shattered in September 2011, when Terri Greene's parents discovered that their daughter and her husband, Michael Greene, a retired Michigan State Police detective, had been brutally murdered. Michael was found inside their home. Terri was found floating in their backyard pond, with a wheelbarrow over her lifeless body. The case was featured on a TV crime show series: == At the time, I was serving as Chief Assistant Prosecutor of Eaton County and was immediately assigned as the lead prosecutor. With no suspect and very little evidence, our team began methodically following every lead. That included drafting piggyback search warrants to track activity on stolen credit cards taken from the home. Those efforts would eventually pay off, but not before the killer nearly got away with it. Working closely with Eaton and Ingham County detectives, we identified the suspected killer as Christopher Perrien. What made this case especially disturbing was that Perrien was already a convicted felon housed in the Eaton County Jail when the home invasion and double homicide occurred. He had been granted work release by the court. Instead of going to work, he spent his days driving through rural Eaton County, casing homes and committing home invasions. He was ultimately identified in part because of his distinctive red Pontiac Trans Am, a vehicle law enforcement knew he prized above everything else. After Perrien was stopped by police, investigators obtained warrants for his storage unit. Inside, they found Mike Greene's stolen firearm and credit cards. A GPS device taken from Perrien's car became the most critical piece of evidence, though its admissibility was a concern. This case became one of the first in Michigan where GPS metadata was accessed through a search warrant and successfully used at trial. That data, or breadcrumbs, placed Perrien at the murder scene and at the locations where the stolen credit cards were used. Our prosecution not only secured justice for the Greene family, it helped change Michigan case law on the use of cellphone and GPS data in criminal prosecutions. We also exposed a serious public safety failure. When dangerous criminals are granted work release without proper vetting, communities pay the price. After a jury trial lasting four weeks, I secured a first-degree murder conviction. Justice was served. And the people of Eaton County were reminded that their safety will always come first. That is the kind of proven dedication and leadership I will bring as Michigan's next Attorney General: Law-focused. Victim-centered. And unwavering in the pursuit of justice. clean_body: Members of Congress should not be trading stocks while writing the laws that affect our economy. | | | | Americans across the political spectrum agree on one thing: Members of Congress should not be trading stocks that influence how they think about an issue as they're writing laws or voting. It's a glaring conflict of interest, and it's long past time to end it. But instead of real reform, House Republicans are pushing a half-baked bill that pretends to fix the problem while letting Members continue to hold and sell stock. It's a smokescreen. Passing a weak bill would only entrench corruption and let Congress pat itself on the back without actually changing anything. This is our moment to do it right. Real reform means a full ban on Congressional stock trading, without loopholes or carve-outs. That's why I support comprehensive, bipartisan legislation like the Restore Trust in Congress Act — a serious proposal that actually puts the public interest first. Anything less is a betrayal of the American people. If Congress can't hold itself to basic ethical standards, how can we expect the public to trust our democracy? Onward! Join Us for Our Heart & Vines Fundraiser

Join Us for Our Annual Hearts & Vines Fundraiser

If you are local to the San Diego area, we warmly invite you to join us for our annual Hearts & Vines Fundraiser, a special evening benefiting Autism Health Inc. This intimate gathering brings our community together to support families impacted by autism while enjoying great food, wine, and meaningful connections.

The event will take place on Saturday, February 21st at 5:00 PM in San Marcos. Guests will enjoy wine generously sponsored by Sunstone Winery (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/sunstonewinery.com/b43o/u9nCAQ/AQ/23f530c9-3f54-4b3a-85af-31b74ab043bf/1/ix1QG0imjA?mc_cid=9fc0658c2f&mc_eid=UNIQID) , delicious hors d’oeuvres, a silent auction, and inspiring presentations from our guest speakers Dr. Sabine Hazan and Dr. Dayan Goodenowe.

Hearts & Vines is one of our favorite evenings of the year, and we would love to share it with our local community. Space is limited, so we encourage you to reserve your spot soon. Registration details can be found in the event image and upcoming announcements.

We look forward to raising a glass with you for a meaningful cause.
REGISTER HERE (https://givebutter.com/2026_HnV?gbtid=1d985c25-9560-4790-bd0b-8a1a4a73c409&mc_cid=9fc0658c2f&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The Autism Health Summit is our flagship educational event, bringing together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health for three powerful days of learning, connection, and collaboration. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates who are seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

We are honored to welcome an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore cutting-edge research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can use. body:
I’m not a standard politician.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123690959/596248096/-1838607967?amount=15&refcode=email_012026_pourRS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMmU5MWYwNS0yZWY2LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UBk4U8Xh65oQiDWAr9KsakWyRAAJnmkxODU0B_L04O0=) John Hickenlooper here. Have a sec? 🍻 I’m not your standard politician. For years, I was a geologist. Then, our company got bought, and we all got laid off. I took every scrap of savings in my bank account, even put my house up as collateral, to open a restaurant (with a brewery) in downtown Denver. We were known for our flagship brews, like Timberline Pale Ale and Sagebrush Stout. We charged just $2.25 a pint. I loved the brewpub. I loved bringing people together from all over with different opinions and creating a team to deliver them something special, something they would tell their friends about. And let me tell you, there was nothing we couldn’t solve over a nice, cold beer. I didn’t run for office for fame, or money, or power. I ran for Senate because I wanted to bring people together and _actually_ get stuff done. subject: Year 1 into Trump’s second term

body:
Today marks one year since Donald Trump returned to the White House.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260120-5830-footer&t=1&akid=5830%2E420207%2EdkuImK)
It’s been a _hell_ of a year, Peter.
Today marks one year since Donald Trump returned to the White House, and it saddens me to say that our country has only gone backwards.
Since Trump took office:
* Jobs for workers without college degrees have fallen by hundreds of thousands.
* Manufacturing jobs have disappeared. Wage growth has slowed.
* Electricity bills are higher. Groceries cost more. And tariffs have driven up the price of everyday essentials.
* Attacks on Yemen and Venezuela were conducted without congressional approval.
* Trump is threatening to seize Greenland by force.
* We’ve experienced nationwide ICE raids marked by illegal arrests, violence, and even deaths, tearing thousands of families apart.

**This is what authoritarianism looks like, Peter.**
This last year has been difficult to say the least, but I refuse to stand idly by while Trump destroys our country.
I have been fighting every day to slow the harm, demand accountability, and stand up for workers, immigrants, and families. **But the single biggest way we can begin to undo this damage is by flipping the House.**
A Democratic House majority means real oversight. Real investigations. Real leverage to rein in Trump’s abuses of power and block the worst of his agenda. But we’re going to need the resources and the grassroots power to make that happen.

# [Trump eyes Greenland grab for Golden Dome shield](https://substack.com/redirect/098ad74b-8eae-4e16-8d6a-e947377a4c99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent declared **[Greenland essential](https://substack.com/redirect/fcf01658-96d2-4b41-b6c6-dd1c0bde1d5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to President Trump's ambitious "Golden Dome" missile defense shield, arguing U.S. control of the Arctic island is **[vital to prevent foreign conquest](https://substack.com/redirect/fcf01658-96d2-4b41-b6c6-dd1c0bde1d5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and avoid dragging America into a hot conflict. Bessent made the case Tuesday at the World Economic Forum in Davos.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fcf01658-96d2-4b41-b6c6-dd1c0bde1d5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strategic Arctic Prize** : Greenland's location and melting ice unlock new shipping routes and vast resources, making it increasingly attractive for foreign powers seeking control in the region.
* **Missile Shield Integration** : The "Golden Dome" system requires Greenland as a key component to protect the Western Hemisphere, with Trump inviting Canada to participate if it shares costs.
* **Preventive Security Move** : Bessent stressed U.S. ownership would deter incursions, avoiding scenarios where NATO obligations force America to defend Greenland militarily against aggressors.
* **Historical U.S. Interest** : Trump has long advocated acquiring Greenland for national security, a priority echoed in recent Truth Social posts and tied to modern defense needs like the Golden Dome project.

# **[Trump Greenland Crisis Ignites Gold Silver Surge](https://substack.com/redirect/098ad74b-8eae-4e16-8d6a-e947377a4c99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Gold **[soared past $4700 an ounce and silver hit $95](https://substack.com/redirect/098ad74b-8eae-4e16-8d6a-e947377a4c99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Tuesday as President Trump escalated his push to acquire Greenland, threatening steep tariffs on European nations and fueling fears of currency debasement, geopolitical turmoil, and a roaring rally in precious metals as safe-haven assets.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/098ad74b-8eae-4e16-8d6a-e947377a4c99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Debasement Trade Explodes** : Analyst Robin Brooks declares the debasement trade on fire, with precious metals serving as primary outlets amid eroding confidence in fiat currencies and fiscal concerns.
* **Silver Supply Crisis Deepens** : Structural deficits persist for five years, worsened by China's export restrictions to prioritize domestic solar panel production and 15 years of mining underinvestment.
* **Geopolitical Fuel Added** : Trump's renewed Greenland demands and potential 200% tariffs on items like French champagne intensify macro unease, pouring fresh momentum into months-long precious metals rally.
* **Industrial Demand Risks Rise** : At elevated prices near $90-$95, silver faces potential demand destruction in supply chains, though experts warn supply cannot match growing industrial and investment needs.

# [Tech stocks crushed over Trump's Greenland tariff threats](https://substack.com/redirect/6464e02f-e3ec-4bd8-a17f-b649ca7367be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tech stocks **[spearheaded a sharp Wall Street sell-off Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/6464e02f-e3ec-4bd8-a17f-b649ca7367be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as President Trump escalated tensions over Greenland, threatening tariffs up to 25% on European allies opposing a U.S. purchase of the strategic Arctic territory, sparking fears of broader transatlantic trade war amid the Davos summit.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6464e02f-e3ec-4bd8-a17f-b649ca7367be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

# [Trump slams NYSE Dallas move as "Unbelievably Bad" for New York](https://substack.com/redirect/673e0280-4fa0-4752-b5e4-af6f8bd72f5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Donald Trump blasted the New York Stock Exchange's plans to expand with a fully electronic equities operation in Dallas, calling it **["unbelievably bad"](https://substack.com/redirect/673e0280-4fa0-4752-b5e4-af6f8bd72f5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for New York and a major test for the city's new mayor, Zohran Mamdani, amid ongoing capital flight to low-tax Texas.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/673e0280-4fa0-4752-b5e4-af6f8bd72f5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump 's Fiery Criticism** : Trump posted on Truth Social that building a New York Stock Exchange in Dallas undermines the city and challenges Mayor Mamdani's leadership.
* **NYSE Texas Details** : The expansion creates NYSE Texas by reincorporating NYSE Chicago for electronic trading, serving southern companies without replacing New York operations.
* **Dallas Mayor 's Response** : Eric Johnson hailed the shift as inevitable, branding Dallas a "Sanctuary City from Socialism" attracting Wall Street firms fleeing high taxes and hostility.
* **Broader Migration Trend** : High-tax blue states like New York and California lost billions in taxable income to Texas and Florida between 2012 and 2022.

# [Frigid blast sends natural gas prices soaring](https://substack.com/redirect/36f350cc-3f7d-404e-b51e-e2d6b90d4d52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Natural **[gas futures surged 25% to $3.89](https://substack.com/redirect/36f350cc-3f7d-404e-b51e-e2d6b90d4d52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** per mmBtu Tuesday as a brutal cold snap gripped the U.S., with Arctic air and a major winter storm forecast to spike heating demand and threaten production freeze-offs across much of the country this week.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/36f350cc-3f7d-404e-b51e-e2d6b90d4d52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Frigid weather reshapes outlook:** Arctic air masses sweep eastern U.S., with huge demand gains from MLK weekend threatening severe market dislocation and potential production freeze-offs.
* **Futures post massive gain:** Prices jumped 78 cents to $3.89/mmBtu by mid-morning, marking the best single-day performance in four years amid heating and power needs.
* **Storm threatens widespread impact:** Heavy snow, sleet, and freezing rain expected across Southern Rockies, Plains, and South by Friday, shifting to East Coast over weekend.
* **Volatility looms with risks:** High speculator short positions at 14-month peak signal bullish pressure, though mid-February warming could soften spikes in turbulent market.

#
Today marks one year since Donald Trump returned to the White House.
It’s been a hell of a decade. And we’re all feeling it.
In a minute, I’m going to break down what this past year has looked like. [**But if you’re already with me, will you donate right now to help me fight back and win back the House?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1274?c0=mcb-em-20260120-1.XIINgf&refcode=em20260120-2708&t=1&akid=2708%2E21716%2EfenNGK)

Let’s take a look at **what Trump promised:** lowering costs for working families.
**Here’s what he’s delivered:** Rewarding his billionaire buddies at the expense of Medicaid and SNAP cuts. Dismantling the Department of Education. Pardoning insurrectionists. Pushing ICE as his personal paramilitary force, using its massive budget to tear families apart.
This is what _corruption_ and _cruelty_ look like. And unfortunately, he’ll be in the White House for the next three years.

Thank you,
Sarah McBride

name: Team Slotkin
subject: Promises made. Promises broken.
body:
[ https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1001&akid=2405%2E135344%2Elf_qcU ][IMG]

Stop. *Record scratch. Freeze frame.*

You may be wondering how this girl:

IMAGE: Elissa Slotkin as a toddler

Ended up here:

IMAGE: Elissa serving her first tour in Iraq as a CIA analyst

Serving my first of three tours in Iraq as a CIA analyst in Iraq, working to understand terrorist and militia groups that were targeting US forces and Iraqi civilians and plotting against the U.S.

It started on 9/11. One of the big moments that changed my life.

I was 24 years old, and I happened to be in New York City on my second day of grad school. By the time the dust had settled, I knew that I wanted to go into national security and protect my country.

Several months later, the CIA came to campus and my favorite professor encouraged me to hear what they had to say. Not wanting to disappoint him, I went. I applied, got the job, and after a lengthy background check, I started in Langley as an analyst.

It wasn’t long before I found myself in Iraq, my first of three deployments.

Going from the national security world to politics was a major culture shock. For 16 years, I didn’t talk publicly about my work—when I posted on Facebook that I was thinking about running for Congress, people asked me if I’d been hacked. One thing I definitely hadn’t done was ask people for money.

To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. When you're running to win a seat in a swing state like Michigan, you can't take anything for granted.

If keeping Michigan's Senate seat blue this November feels worth it to you, that's the donation I am asking you to make to my campaign today.

DONATE: https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/921?t=1002&akid=2405%2E135344%2Elf_qcU

Thank you,

Elissa

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

name: Chris Pappas
subject: What we’re facing, one year into the Trump Administration
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=4676%2E582294%2EutQ9Ja ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=4676%2E582294%2EutQ9Ja ]Chris Pappas for Senate

Today marks one year since Donald Trump took office.

Before I get into the consequences of his second presidency, remember that
flipping the Senate is our chance to put a check on his recklessness.
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260120_1.INRFUX&refcode=em20260120-1&t=1003&akid=4676%2E582294%2EutQ9Ja ]Please consider making a donation to fuel the fight to defend New
Hampshire’s Senate seat.

One year into his second term, Trump has created a culture of fear and
destruction in America.

Tariffs are increasing the prices of everyday items for everyone, hurting
working families’ bottom line and small businesses’ ability to grow and
hire. Health care premiums are skyrocketing, and millions of Americans
will be forced off their health insurance. And the administration is
weaponizing the Department of Justice to go after anyone who stands in
their way.

This is not normal.

This country is meant to be a place where everyone can thrive. But Trump
and his allies are building a system to line the pockets of billionaires
while working families are left to fend for themselves – a system that
works against us, our economy, and our democracy.

We can’t live like this. I’m running for Senate to
fix the broken system.

I’m proud to be on the frontlines fighting for the rights of Granite
Staters. I’m building a campaign that is dedicated to the working families
who make New Hampshire what it is.

But I can’t do it alone.

This is going to be one of the most competitive races in the country, and
the forces that profit from this broken system are ready to spend big to
stop us from winning. That’s why your investment now will power us through
November.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260120_1.INRFUX&refcode=em20260120-1&t=1004&akid=4676%2E582294%2EutQ9Ja ]If you’re able to, please step up to help by making a donation to my
campaign for the first
time.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260120_1.INRFUX&amount=5&refcode=em20260120-1&t=1023&akid=4676%2E582294%2EutQ9Ja ]Donate $5 »

Together we can flip the Senate. And when we do, we will build a country
that serves working families and stands up to MAGA extremism.

Onwards,

Chris Pappas

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=4676%2E582294%2EutQ9Ja

Friend,

One important thing I’ve learned on the campaign trail is that every voice matters. And take it from me -- I flipped this seat in 2024 by just 653 votes.

From the beginning, we’ve established a strong on-the-ground field program to reach Californians where they’re at.

_Last week, we joined neighbors in Stanton for our first canvass of the year!_
**This is a truly grassroots movement that is powered by every volunteer, every door knocked, every yard sign waved, every call or text sent, and every voice heard.**

I’m facing a new challenge this election year: My first re-election campaign. There are already four Republican challengers in the race who want nothing more than to flip CA‐45 back to red and keep the MAGA House majority.

We can’t let that happen, and ensuring our field program is well-funded to reach voters is critical -- especially now that Prop 50 has folded thousands of new voters into the district who have never seen my name on a ballot.

Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders.

In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by hanging.

**I recently learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.**

This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end of last year.

As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of political authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night.

[ https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-heinrich2026.lFF-GH&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_VIP_AC_20260120_PM1_V1_S1&t=1002&akid=3848%2E898137%2E6WWWi_ ][IMG]

Hey there, U.S. Senator Martin Heinrich here.

I don’t often wade into other states’ primaries. In fact, I’ve only done
it in three states so far this cycle. But today, I want to tell you why
I’m endorsing Mallory McMorrow — and why I’d appreciate you joining me to
support her.

Some folks in D.C. have decided they’re going to try and sway this race.
The kind of establishment meddling that drives people crazy: Washington
insiders thinking they know better than voters who should represent them.

I can’t stand that kind of politics. And I refuse to sit on the sidelines
and watch it happen.

That’s why I’m endorsing Mallory McMorrow.

If I’ve already told you enough, and you’re ready to support Mallory too,
you can donate with my personal link here:
[ https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-heinrich2026.lFF-GH&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_VIP_AC_20260120_PM1_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=3848%2E898137%2E6WWWi_ ]secure.actblue.com/donate/mam-em-heinrich2026

Mallory has fought to expand the earned income tax credit in Michigan,
held the line on clean water access, and taken on price gouging that’s
squeezing working families. She doesn't just talk about fighting for
people, she actually does it — even when it's hard, and especially when it
matters most.

Michiganders couldn’t ask for a stronger champion for their rights and
freedoms, and I couldn’t imagine a better partner to join me in the U.S.
Senate.

But if you need some more info, here’s what’s at stake: Republicans see
Michigan as a golden ticket to flipping a Democratic seat red. They’ve
seen that Mallory was outraised by Mike Rogers, and they’ve seen the
polling that shows she’s the only candidate in this primary who can beat
him in a head-to-head general election match-up.

So yeah, they’re scared. And on top of that, she’s built a movement of
people who are fed up with the BS they’ve seen in Washington. A movement
of people who are ready to fight for a government that actually works for
them. People who are sick and tired of the Washington establishment
misreading the moment and running scared instead of being bold.

[ https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-heinrich2026.lFF-GH&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_VIP_AC_20260120_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=3848%2E898137%2E6WWWi_ ]Please help me make sure Mallory has what she needs to win. Every bit
helps — seriously.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your

When I first ran for office, I didn’t have a long background in politics
or a family history of campaigning.

I saw my community needed someone to step up, and I couldn’t sit back.

That’s the kind of leader Mallory is. She’s not backed by corporate
donors; she’s counting on grassroots supporters who believe in her vision
for the New American Dream.

I know that Mallory will be an incredible champion for her state in the
U.S. Senate, just as she’s been in the State Senate. Now more than ever,
we need strong voices who aren’t afraid to speak out and call out the
bullshit when they see it. That’s Mallory.

join me in supporting Mallory for Senate. Can you pitch in to her campaign
today?

Thanks for being part of this. We’re in it together.

Martin

body:

[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._a3w/seu64c80a7c)
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump._a3w/sagdc43095c)
Friend,
One year ago today, I was sworn in as your President AGAIN.
This morning, I took a moment to reflect on everything it took us to get here... and everything we’ve already accomplished together in just one year back in office.
This road was long. It was hard. And it was unlike anything our country has ever seen.
**I guess the fun really started when they ARRESTED ME in Fulton County, Georgia.** That was truly a dark day in American history.
They even took my mugshot which became an iconic symbol of the MAGA movement’s fight to NEVER SURRENDER under the tyranny of the Biden-Harris regime.
**Then, they REMOVED ME from the ballot in Colorado.**
Democrats launched hoax after hoax and witch hunt after witch hunt in Florida, New York, Georgia, and Washington DC!
One of my favorite nights was our historic LANDSLIDE on Super Tuesday. True Trump patriots responded in RECORD numbers.
That’s when they CONVICTED ME of 34 bogus felonies in New York.
**THEN THEY TRIED TO ASSASSINATE ME, NOT ONCE BUT TWICE!** Your love is the only thing that kept me going through it all.
I was still bandaged up when I secured the nomination at the Republican National Convention!
I made a promise to never quit. I WILL NEVER SURRENDER, so I made my triumphant return back to Butler, PA where **I WAS SHOT!**
Finally, the American people spoke loud and clear and helped me deliver a **__HISTORIC ELECTION LANDSLIDE!__**
Now, here we are — one year back — fighting every day to revive America.
And I want you to know something: **none of this would have been possible without YOU.**

Beto founded Powered by People to change that.
We’re out registering new voters across Texas long before an election—especially young people and Texans who have been ignored by the political system for far too long. But we don’t stop there. clean_body: They’re changing the rules before the election even starts | = Peter, Have you seen the latest news? = = | = Five years ago, Donald Trump tried to pressure election officials to "find" him votes after he lost. Now, he's doing something even more dangerous: trying to change the rules before the 2026 midterm elections even begin. Across the country, Trump and his allies are pushing an all-out effort to tilt the playing field — redrawing congressional maps mid-decade, attacking mail-in voting, undermining voting machines, demanding voters' private information, and staffing key federal agencies with election-deniers who still refuse to accept the results of 2020. The goal is simple and chilling: hold onto power at all costs; and if they lose, cast doubt on the legitimacy of the election itself. But EMILYs List women are fighting back. This past November, we expanded our majority in Virginia's House of Delegates and flipped Republican-held seats across the country. Now, these Democratic pro-choice women are on track to stand up to Republican gerrymanders of Texas, Missouri, North Carolina, and Florida with new congressional maps that could flip three or four seats. It's really not rocket science, and it works.
Peter,

We've been talking about shifting tides since last year — and it's because we're seeing something real happen on the ground.

Democrats across the country are winning or overperforming in tough races in predominantly red areas. To close out 2025, a State Senate seat in Kentucky stayed in Democratic hands because the candidate made it clear he was running for working families.

Gary Clemons, a proud union leader, centered his campaign on the real challenges Kentuckians face — jobs that pay a living wage, affordable healthcare, childcare, and dignity at work. Voters heard him, and they showed up. Gary won 72% of the vote, overperforming by a huge margin and proving yet again that when Democrats run on issues that matter to everyday people, they win and win big.

That's the model at In This Together PAC. Across the country, we're seeing Democrats outperform expectations when they lead with affordability, compassion, and common sense. When we invest early in candidates who know their communities and aren't afraid to fight for them, **we win.**

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: From Houston to the Valley
body:
From Houston to the Valley, the message is the same. Texans are tired and ready for change.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
I kicked off the New Year visiting nine cities in seven days on the campaign trail. And I need to tell you what I heard.
**Before I do, we're only 2 days out from our first major pre-primary fundraising deadline on January 22nd.[Can you donate $5 to help us hit our $100,000 goal and keep this campaign moving?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&refcode=em20260120-446&amount=5&t=1&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&amount=5&refcode=em20260120-446&t=20&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)
Getting to hear from my fellow Texans and listening to their stories is one of the best parts about running a campaign like this. Here are a few highlights from the trail:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&refcode=ema20260120-446&t=21&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)
From the Valley and the Coastal Bend to Harris County — Texans are fired up and ready to win.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&refcode=ema20260120-446&t=22&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)
In **Donna** , hundreds turned out on an uncharacteristically chilly night for a rally with **Bobby Pulido** , and the message was clear: _the Valley stands with us._
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&refcode=ema20260120-446&t=23&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)
In **San Antonio** , I visited churches and was moved by stories from working families.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&refcode=ema20260120-446&t=24&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)
I headlined a rally in **Corpus Christi** , highlighting the schools that are facing closure across the Coastal Bend and reminding Democrats in Nueces County that we have a real opportunity to win.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&refcode=ema20260120-446&t=25&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)
I stopped in **Kingsville** and was welcomed by local leaders and voters at a dinner where I heard about concerns with rising costs, ICE overreach, and the ongoing water crisis.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260120_1_recap.QA6mi5&refcode=ema20260120-446&t=26&akid=446%2E299639%2EPRMh1M)

Friend,
Chris Pappas was given a simple question on Close Up: Would you abolish ICE?
**He refused to answer.**
Instead, Pappas dodged, twice — pivoting to complain that Republican majorities are standing in the way of his agenda.
When a politician won’t say where they stand, it’s because they know voters won’t like the truth.
Chris Pappas called ICE “unacceptable.” He proposed cutting their funding. And when pressed on whether he would abolish the agency altogether, he refused to answer.
_Why? Because if Democrats had the power, that’s exactly what they would do._
**Thanks to Republican leadership, New Hampshire banned sanctuary cities and strengthened cooperation with federal law enforcement. Republicans made it clear: New Hampshire will not be a safe haven for criminals.**
**Chris Pappas wants to undo that.**
And he all but admitted it — blaming Republicans for stopping him.
That’s why THIS moment is crucial.
Democrats are flooding New Hampshire with Washington money, pushing the same liberal agenda that’s turned other states into chaos. If they gain power, they will defund ICE, weaken enforcement, and open our borders.
**We need your help right now.**

SB26-005: Colorado Bill Opens State Suits for ICE-Related Rights Violations—Even Against Private Actors
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s2o79aa7ce2)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s5ka53da3a3)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sbve4ed5e14), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s5sd9820869) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sbr950e7306). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado faced mounting concerns over public safety, spending, and state power as lawmakers advanced a bill[]() [allowing state lawsuits tied to ICE enforcement](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sbh55027740)—even against private citizens—prompting warnings from sheriffs. Medicaid now consumes [nearly one-third of the General Fund](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s6s7701af04), forcing tough budget choices. The state’s plan to [reintroduce wolverines](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/saobbb54c8d) reignited wildlife debate, while arrests tied to [canal-trail explosions](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sesa191cb7b) and [copper theft-driven phone outages](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sbo3dcb5118) highlighted ongoing crime and infrastructure problems.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** National reports warned millions may have been [unknowingly enrolled in zero-premium Obamacare plans](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s8k8c1d778c) through broker abuse of subsidies, leaving taxpayers on the hook. A separate commentary criticized media coverage of ICE enforcement, arguing [key facts are routinely omitted](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s4p51d025d5) while obstruction is reframed as victimhood.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Commentary warned Colorado systems are nearing breaking points, citing [overcrowded prisons](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s9jdbd413d0), a looming PUC hearing that could weaken transparency and local control to [accelerate renewable projects](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s6l8eed63a9), and a [drop of more than 10,000 public-school students](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sas2674f1a4) as families increasingly opt out over safety, academics, and values.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, January 20, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[SB26-005: Colorado Bill Opens State Suits for ICE-Related Rights Violations—Even Against Private Actors](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/scn2cc54594)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sev631b9896)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sbr361ec3ef)
Colorado lawmakers have introduced Senate Bill 26-005—legislation that would allow lawsuits in state court when an individual claims their rights under federal law have been violated as a result of civil immigration law enforcement.
This bill creates a new state-level cause of action tied specifically to immigration enforcement activity. Its reach is broad. The text applies to “any person whether or not under color of law,” language pulled directly from the bill as introduced.
The prime sponsors of the bill are Sen. Mike Weissman, Sen. Julie Gonzales, Rep. Javier Mabrey, and Rep. Yara Zokaie. It has been sent to the Senate Judiciary Committee—which Weissman chairs. That matters. He will be able to control how fast it moves and what amendments are allowed.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s2l702d1108)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s prisons are on the verge of total collapse.](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s8m70c4f2b7)** BY AHNAF KALAM, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s4g87554c9d)
* **Prisons nearing collapse:** Colorado’s prison system is operating at nearly 98% capacity with severe understaffing, forcing inmates into county jails never designed for long-term housing and pushing correctional officers into burnout and mandatory overtime.
* **Spending priorities under fire:** Despite overcrowding and staffing shortages, the Department of Corrections is hiring a six-figure, taxpayer-funded “gender-affirming care” provider, raising concerns that ideology is being prioritized over basic safety, security, and rehabilitation.
* **Public safety and accountability concerns:** The commentary warns that policies driven by ideological mandates—such as inmate transfers and specialized medical programs—risk compromising women’s safety, increasing lawsuits, and diverting scarce resources away from victims and core prison functions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sck827dea9f)**
|

|
---
**[Beyond the baby bust: Parents quietly exit Colorado public schools](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sbve5809209)** BY CHRISTIAN HORSTMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s6n9936a955)
* **Public school enrollment is falling fast:** Colorado’s public schools lost more than 10,000 students this year, the steepest drop since the pandemic, affecting every major district and accelerating school closures—despite claims that overcrowding remains a problem.
* **Parents are opting out, not just aging out:** While state officials point to falling birth rates and population shifts, the commentary argues a major driver is parents actively choosing to leave the public system, as homeschooling has increased 5.5% in a single year and nearly 20% since 2022.
* **Safety, academics, and values are pushing families away:** The article cites concerns over school safety, declining academic performance, and ideological content as key reasons parents are taking direct responsibility for their children’s education, signaling a growing vote of no confidence in Colorado’s public schools.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/sai8df5b775)**
|

[**Know Your Enemy: Lies That Look Like Truth**](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s4ta4bfa548) **BY DRAKE HUNTER | DEVOTIONAL | JANUARY 18** _A vivid memory from my time in the Air Force keeps coming back to me. We were practicing in low visibility in rural Germany (Büchel – 1989) at dusk, navigating unfamiliar terrain under mounting pressure._
__
[**When Rhetoric Escalates: How Polarizing Language Shapes Public Conflict**](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/scr85c10edd)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s2t64551e26)**BY SHAINA COLE | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 16** _Political speech extends well beyond the moment it’s expressed. Words travel. They settle into public discourse and shape how authority, disagreement, and risk are understood over time. Research shows that rhetoric does more than mirror tension._
[**State signals renewed push to override local control on renewable energy siting**](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/seg0b2e42d4)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv._fSw/s3qbd582494)**BY CORY GAINES | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 14** _Governor Polis is signaling a major push this session to fast-track renewable energy projects—likely by weakening local control and rewriting PUC oversight—despite offering few specifics, reinforcing concerns that “energy reform” means overriding rural communities to meet Front Range renewable goals._

I’ve devoted my career to serving my community here in Southwest Michigan, first on the Kalamazoo City Commission and then as a state legislator. And simply put, part of the job of being an elected official is simply showing up.
When you take a stand, explain to your constituents why you took it.
When people want to speak to you about an issue, make the time to listen to them.
When someone asks for your help, help them.
**We’re not talking about something extraordinary. We’re talking about the bare minimum that folks have a right to expect from their representatives. But it’s a test that Bill Huizenga has failed again and again.**
After Huizenga voted to gut Medicaid and give that money to billionaires instead, **_he couldn’t be bothered to hold an in-person town hall — because he would have had to look his constituents in the eye and defend his vote._**
And then during the month-long government shutdown caused by Republicans’ refusal to fund health care? He certainly wasn’t out and about here in Michigan. And Mike Johnson closed down the House of Representatives the entire time, so he wasn’t doing his job in Washington either. **_He appears to have simply taken a vacation._**
And just a few days ago, when local residents concerned about ICE’s lawlessness came to Huizenga’s district office to express their views? Huizenga’s staff **_wouldn’t even open the door._**
